scope: Independent read-only final audit of the integrated four-frame FFT factorization sequence and the FftButterflyLedger, FftCostGrowth, and FftMemoryOrderLedger component figures.

integration_and_roots.evidence: The lesson renders exactly four sibling figure elements and zero nested figure elements. The kebab-case sequence resolves four lesson-local SVG frames; all three PascalCase names resolve through components/figures/index.ts. Component roots are divs, not figure elements. `npm run validate -- digital-signal-processing fft-factorization-and-layout` reports 0 errors and 0 warnings.

factorization_sequence.evidence: Frames 1-4 correctly reveal direct sums, the E/O combine, two DFT4 branches, then four DFT2 leaves. Bit-reversed input [0,4,2,6,1,5,3,7], natural X[0..7], W2^0, W4^{0,1}, W8^{0,1,2,3}, X[q]=E[q]+W8^q O[q], X[q+4]=E[q]-W8^q O[q], and the 64/56 versus 12/24 ledgers are exact. Each source has one SVG root, viewBox 0 0 640 370, role=img, linked title/desc, and no fixed dimensions. After normalizing only the root frame class, all four SHA-256 hashes equal 1b37b7cb1cafb3458ba6e1365cc62f29473f808341c27a9fdb1c5e5b28cc9733, proving coordinate invariance.

component_math_and_labels.evidence: FftButterflyLedger correctly computes W8^1(1-j)=-sqrt(2)j, u=3+j(2-sqrt(2)), v=3+j(2+sqrt(2)), and enforces read-compute-write. FftCostGrowth exactly matches N^2 and (N/2)log2 N at N=8,16,64,256,1024, keeps additions separate, and does not invent a runtime crossover. FftMemoryOrderLedger exactly maps N=8 to [0,4,2,6,1,5,3,7] and [3,4] mixed-radix storage to [0,3,6,9,1,4,7,10,2,5,8,11] from n=d0+3d1 and p=d1+4d0.

render_and_responsiveness.evidence: Fresh standalone and integrated renders were inspected in light and dark. At 312px and 360px, document scroll width equals viewport width and all four figures avoid horizontal clipping. However, the integrated FftMemoryOrderLedger media query stacks the state grid and rotates the whole `inverse permutation ->` text without reserving height. At 312px its transformed box spans y=2954.52..3218.52 while the two state cards occupy 3014.41..3073.44 and 3099.59..3158.63; at 360px it spans 2880.42..3192.42 across cards at 2964.31..3023.34 and 3049.50..3108.53. The vertical label visibly crosses both cards in both themes. The standalone `frame=360` render does not expose this because forced-mobile inline layout is evaluated in an 800px browser viewport.

accessibility_and_copy.evidence: All four lesson embeds have accurate non-color alt text and takeaway captions. The sequence exposes its current step plus named Previous/Next buttons; the source SVGs and internal charts retain descriptive image names. The long memory-order alternative text explicitly states both permutations and the restore-before-k rule.

key_image.evidence: course.yaml configures figures/fft-even-odd-factorization-4.svg, and that lesson-local file exists as the complete final sequence frame.

tooling.evidence: Targeted ESLint for all three component files and `npx tsc --noEmit` both complete with no diagnostics.

blocking_findings.finding: The integrated 312px and 360px layouts rotate the full inverse-permutation label through both state cards. Reserve a real transition row or keep the label horizontal with a downward arrow, then recheck both themes at actual narrow viewports.
